name: kb-agent-label-print
description: W6-B3 food-compliance label-print SPA: zero-dependency Code128/GS1-128 SVG encoder (src/code128.ts — the same module approval-engine.mts serves /label/lot.svg from), batch templates with the legal minimum lines (食安法第 50/51 条), browser printing via window.print. Built by esbuild into dist/ and served by approval-engine.mts --serve under /labels; the built bundle is committed so a fresh checkout serves without a build step.
